"""记录一次实验调用的源码、退出状态和原始输出，拒绝覆盖已有记录。"""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--record", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, action="append", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if not command:
        parser.error("需要指定 Python 脚本及其参数")
    target = args.record.resolve()
    script = Path(command[0]).resolve()
    if not target.is_relative_to(ROOT) or target.exists() or not target.parent.is_dir():
        parser.error("记录须位于工作区已有目录，且不得覆盖")
    if not script.is_relative_to(ROOT) or not script.is_file():
        parser.error("脚本须为工作区内现有文件")
    inputs = dict.fromkeys([Path(__file__).resolve(), script, *(p.resolve() for p in args.input)])
    snapshots = {}
    for path in inputs:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        snapshots[str(path)] = {"sha256": digest(raw), "source": raw.decode("utf-8")}
    invocation = [sys.executable, str(script), *command[1:]]
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    process = subprocess.run(invocation, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1"), capture_output=True)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - begin
    changed = [str(path) for path in inputs if not path.is_file() or digest(path.read_bytes()) != snapshots[str(path)]["sha256"]]
    record = {
        "started_at_utc": started,
        "completed_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "command": invocation, "returncode": process.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
        "input_sources_before_execution": snapshots, "changed_inputs": changed,
        "stdout": process.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr": process.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
    }
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"record": str(target), "returncode": process.returncode,
                      "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "changed_inputs": changed}, ensure_ascii=False))
    print(record["stdout"][-3500:])
    if record["stderr"]:
        print(record["stderr"][-3500:])
    return process.returncode or (1 if changed else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def workspace_source(original, actual):
    require(all(raw.count(b'\r\n') > 0 and raw.count(b'\r\n') == raw.count(b'\r') == raw.count(b'\n') for raw in (original, actual)), '父和实际IPM完整CRLF，不转换外部字节')
    start = actual.index(b'struct V108DirectWorkspace {'); end = actual.index(b'class KktFactor {', start)
    helper = actual[start:end]; restored = actual[:start] + actual[end:]
    require(helper.count(b'= delete;') == 4 and helper.count(b'if (pool_) work_.swap(*pool_);') == 2 and
        b'reduced_rhs.swap(other.reduced_rhs);' in helper and b'permuted.swap(other.permuted);' in helper, '实际Lease禁止复制移动并无异常swap借还')
    changes = ((
        '  mutable V108DirectWorkspace v108_direct_workspace_;\n', ''), (
        '    const bool v108_reuse_workspace = solver_v100_coupled_state::enabled();\n'
        '    V108DirectWorkspaceLease v108_scratch(v108_reuse_workspace ? &v108_direct_workspace_ : nullptr);\n'
        '    auto& v108_workspace = v108_scratch.get();\n', ''), (
        '      auto& permuted = v108_workspace.permuted;\n      permuted.resize(dimension_);\n', '      std::vector<double> permuted(dimension_);\n'), (
        '    auto& reduced_rhs = v108_workspace.reduced_rhs;\n    reduced_rhs.resize(factor_dimension_);\n', '    std::vector<long double> reduced_rhs(factor_dimension_, 0);\n'), (
        '    auto& permuted = v108_workspace.permuted;\n    permuted.resize(factor_dimension_);\n', '    std::vector<double> permuted(factor_dimension_);\n'))
    for before, after in changes:
        before, after = before.replace('\n', '\r\n').encode('utf-8'), after.replace('\n', '\r\n').encode('utf-8')
        require(restored.count(before) == 1, '工作区预算/声明还原锚唯一'); restored = restored.replace(before, after, 1)
    require(restored == original, '只读剔除六类存储组织后完整父106原字节恢复，不生成C++')
    return dict(passed=True, change_classes=6, original_crlf_bytes_restored=True, fp_expressions_order_and_checks_preserved=True,
        answer_remains_owned=True, helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256(helper).hexdigest(), source_emitted=False, actual_malloc_count_measured=False)


def source_evidence(plan):
    for base, key in ((DATA, 'design'), (DATA, 'algorithm_parent_evidence'), (ROOT, 'source_parent_identity'), (ROOT, 'source_parent_build')):
        require(sha(base / plan[key + '_file']) == plan[key + '_sha256'], '冻结设计/父来源：' + key)
    parent = read(ROOT / plan['source_parent_identity_file']); actual, origins = {}, {}
    require(plan['algorithm_parent_version'] == 106 and len(plan['sources']) == plan['source_count'] == 11, '父106与十一源')
    for item in plan['sources']:
        name = item['canonical']; B.canonical_relative(name); path = WORK / 'source' / name; origin = ROOT / item['source']
        require(path.resolve().is_relative_to(WORK / 'source') and sha(path) == item['canonical_sha256'] and sha(origin) == item['source_sha256'] == parent['protected'][str(origin)], '来源与不可变快照：' + name)
        actual[name], origins[name] = path, origin
    changed = {'src/experimental/ipm.cpp', 'tests/experimental/ipm_self_test.cpp'}
    require({name for name in actual if actual[name].read_bytes() != origins[name].read_bytes()} == changed, '仅IPM/test两变，其余九源逐字父106，不叠107')
    proof = workspace_source(origins['src/experimental/ipm.cpp'].read_bytes(), actual['src/experimental/ipm.cpp'].read_bytes())
    audit_path = DATA / plan['source_static_audit_file']; require(sha(audit_path) == plan['source_static_audit_sha256'], '冻结独立源码审计身份')
    audit = read(audit_path); name = 'src/experimental/ipm.cpp'
    require(audit['passed'] is True and audit['source_generation'] is False and audit['public_lp_runs'] == 0 and audit['source_file'] == name and
        audit['source_sha256'] == sha(actual[name]) and audit['parent_sha256'] == sha(origins[name]), '独立审计绑定实际源码及父字节，按真实标量SHA字段核对')
    proof['independent_helper_sha256'] = audit['helper_sha256']
    return dict(passed=True, algorithm_parent_version=106, source_files=11, unchanged_parent_sources=9, changed_files=sorted(changed),
        workspace_source=proof, source_snapshot_sha256={name: sha(path) for name, path in actual.items()}, source_generation=False, public_report_fields_added=0)


def build_evidence(plan):
    identity, build = C.verify_work(WORK, PLAN); before = read(WORK / 'build-before.json'); verify(build['compile_dependencies'])

    for a, b in (('commands', 'commands'), ('source_snapshot', 'source_snapshot'), ('protected_before', 'protected'), ('source_origins_at_build', 'source_origins_at_build')):

    template_path = WORK / 'provenance/command-template.json'; require(sha(template_path) == B.TEMPLATE_SHA, '原编译链接模板')
    template = read(template_path); old_work = Path(template['executable']).parent; cwd = Path(template['commands']['cwd'])
    normal_path = WORK / 'provenance/normal-command-template.json'; normal_spec = plan['normal_compile_template']
    require(sha(normal_path) == normal_spec['sha256'] == sha(ROOT / normal_spec['file']), 'normal干净模板')
    normal = read(normal_path)
    for key in normal_spec['command_key']: normal = normal[key]
    shared = {'include/solver/experimental/coupled.hpp', 'include/solver/experimental/fma_axpy.hpp', 'src/experimental/coupled_state.hpp', 'src/experimental/diagnostic_state.hpp'}
    ipm = shared | {'src/experimental/ipm.cpp', 'src/experimental/presolve_state.hpp', 'include/solver/experimental/energy.hpp'}
    deps = {'ipm': ipm, 'ipm_self': ipm | {'tests/experimental/ipm_self_test.cpp'}, 'normal': shared | {'src/experimental/normal_cholesky.cpp', 'include/solver/experimental/energy.hpp'},
        'coupled_self': {'include/solver/experimental/coupled.hpp', 'include/solver/experimental/fma_axpy.hpp', 'include/solver/experimental/energy.hpp', 'include/solver/experimental/legacy_coupled.hpp', 'tests/experimental/coupled_self_test.cpp'}}
    units = {'ipm': 'src/experimental/ipm.cpp', 'ipm_self': 'tests/experimental/ipm_self_test.cpp', 'coupled_self': 'tests/experimental/coupled_self_test.cpp', 'normal': 'src/experimental/normal_cholesky.cpp'}
    require(set(build['commands']['compile']) == set(units), '四个实际编译单元')
    for role, name in units.items():

        original = normal if role == 'normal' else template['commands']['compile']['ipm'] if role == 'ipm' else template['commands']['math_self_tests'][role.removesuffix('_self')]['compile']
        command = B.adapt_normal_compile(original, source, obj, WORK) if role == 'normal' else B.adapt_compile(original, source, obj, WORK, template)
        raw = read(WORK / (role + '-compile.json')); paths = B.dependencies(Path(str(obj) + '.d'), cwd); record = build['dependency_records'][role]
        require(raw['command'] == build['commands']['compile'][role] == command and raw['cwd'] == str(cwd) and raw['returncode'] == 0 and not raw['wall_timeout'], '原编译选项只重绑路径')
        require({path.relative_to(WORK / 'source').as_posix() for path in paths if path.is_relative_to(WORK / 'source')} == deps[role] and sha(Path(str(obj) + '.d')) == record['sha256'] and set(record['paths']) == {str(path) for path in paths}, '真实.d精确依赖')
        require(not any(path.is_relative_to(DATA) or path.is_relative_to(old_work) or path.is_relative_to(ROOT / 'include') or path.is_relative_to(ROOT / 'src/experimental') or path.is_relative_to(ROOT / 'tests/experimental') or (path.suffix == '.cpp' and not path.is_relative_to(WORK / 'source')) for path in paths), '不混编活动、生产或旧数学源')
    require({role: len(value) for role, value in deps.items()} == plan['expected_dependency_counts'] == {'ipm': 7, 'ipm_self': 8, 'coupled_self': 5, 'normal': 6}, '依赖7/8/5/6')
    substitutions = {str(old_work / old): str(WORK / new) for old, new in (('ipm-presolve.obj', 'ipm.obj'), ('ipm-self.obj', 'ipm_self.obj'), ('coupled-self.obj', 'coupled_self.obj'))}
    for role in ('solver', 'ipm', 'coupled'):
        original = template['commands']['link'] if role == 'solver' else template['commands']['math_self_tests'][role]['link']; command = [substitutions.get(value, value) for value in original]
        if role != 'coupled':
            require(command.count('libsolver_normal_cholesky.a') == 1, '原normal库唯一'); command[command.index('libsolver_normal_cholesky.a')] = str(WORK / 'normal.obj')
        command[command.index('-o') + 1] = str(WORK / ('solver-experimental.exe' if role == 'solver' else role + '-self-test.exe')); raw = read(WORK / (role + '-link.json'))
        require(raw['command'] == build['commands']['link'][role] == command and raw['cwd'] == str(cwd) and raw['returncode'] == 0 and not raw['wall_timeout'] and command.count(str(WORK / 'normal.obj')) == (0 if role == 'coupled' else 1) and not any(Path(value).name in ('libsolver_normal_cholesky.a', 'libsolver_ipm.a') for value in command), '原normal唯一位置替换，其余库原序')
    production = read(DATA / 'ipm-v66-identity.json'); require(sha(DATA / 'ipm-v66-identity.json') == plan['parent_identity_sha256'] and len(production['files']) == 95 and len(production['libraries']) == 17, '原95源17库身份')
    for group, key in (('files', 'production_sources'), ('libraries', 'production_libraries')):
        require(equal(build[key], production[group]), '生产清单不变'); verify({str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in production[group].items()})
    require(sha(ROOT / 'build/release/solver.exe') == sha(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe') == production['solver_sha256'] == plan['production_sha256'], '生产程序未改')
    parent_work = (ROOT / plan['source_parent_identity_file']).parent; math = {}
    for role, count in plan['verification']['component_cases'].items():
        raw, check = read(WORK / (role + '-self-run.json')), read(WORK / (role + '-self-check.json')); detail = B.parse(raw['stdout']); previous = read(parent_work / (role + '-self-check.json'))['details']
        require(raw['command'] == [str(WORK / (role + '-self-test.exe'))] and raw['cwd'] == str(ROOT) and raw['returncode'] == 0 and not raw['wall_timeout'] and raw['stderr'] == '' and check['passed'] is True and check['public_lp_runs'] == 0 and detail['passed'] is True and detail['public_lp_runs'] == 0 and detail['cases'] == len(detail['details']) == count and equal(detail, check['details']) and equal(check, build['math_self_tests'][role]), '真实完整组件及输出')
        if role == 'coupled': require(equal(detail, previous), '独立51组完整输出等父106')

            require(detail['details'][:len(previous['details'])] == previous['details'] and len({item['id'] for item in detail['details']}) == count and additions == plan['required_direct_workspace_ipm_cases'] == read(DATA / plan['design_file'])['component_plan']['new_groups'], '父106前序及六新ID/group，不要求新增计数整JSON等父')

def invalid_highs(plan, identity, runner, frozen, error):
    require(str(error) == '程序身份变化', 'highs必须由原严格archive拒绝本次程序身份错误，其他错误不可吞掉')
    clarification_path = DATA / 'v108-identity-clarification.json'; clarification = read(clarification_path)
    require(clarification['version'] == 108 and clarification['comparison_valid'] is False and clarification['goal_achieved'] is False and
        clarification['reason'] == 'highs_solver_identity_mismatch' and clarification['observed_public_lp_runs'] == 500 and clarification['additional_public_lp_runs'] == 0, '只为本次已记录身份异常结项')
    directory = RUNS / 'highs'; raw_path, summary_path = directory / 'runs.jsonl.gz', directory / 'summary.json'
    require(sha(raw_path) == clarification['highs_raw_sha256'] and sha(summary_path) == clarification['highs_summary_sha256'] and
        sha(DATA / 'v108-highs-attempt1.json') == clarification['highs_attempt_sha256'], '完整失败stage、原summary及唯一执行原件保持')
    manifest, summary = read(directory / 'manifest.json'), read(summary_path)
    selected, variants = runner.specification('highs', frozen), runner.variants('highs')
    require(manifest['stage'] == 'highs' and manifest['plan_sha256'] == PLAN_SHA == sha(directory / 'provenance/plan.json') and manifest['work'] == str(WORK) and
        manifest['build_identity_sha256'] == sha(WORK / 'identity.json') and manifest['reference'] == str(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe') and manifest['reference_sha256'] == plan['production_sha256'] and
        manifest['candidate'] == identity['candidate'] and manifest['candidate_sha256'] == identity['candidate_sha256'] and equal(manifest['models'], selected['models']) and
        manifest['variants'] == list(variants) and manifest['repeats'] == selected['repeats'] == 1, '无效阶段仍绑定真实固定91对子与来源')
    with gzip.open(raw_path, 'rt', encoding='utf-8') as stream: observed = [B.parse(line) for line in stream]
    schedule = list(runner.compare_lp.schedule(selected['models'], selected['repeats'], variants))
    require(len(observed) == len(schedule) == manifest['runs'] == summary['run_count'] == 182, '无效stage仍保完整182次观测，不删失败')
    mismatches = []
    for index, (row, (model, repeat, position, variant)) in enumerate(zip(observed, schedule)):
        require((row['run_index'], row['model_index'], row['repetition'], row['position_in_pair'], row['requested_variant'], row['protocol_variant']) ==
            (index, model['model_index'], repeat, position, variant, variant) and row['seed'] == frozen['seed'], '无效stage固定调度观测')
        expected = identity['candidate_sha256'] if variant == 'diagnostic_on' else manifest['reference_sha256']
        if not row['solver_sha256_before'] == row['solver_sha256_after'] == row['frozen_solver_sha256'] == expected:
            mismatches.append(dict(stage='highs', run_index=index, model_index=model['model_index'], input=row['input'], variant=variant,
                **{key: row[key] for key in ('solver_sha256_before', 'solver_sha256_after', 'frozen_solver_sha256', 'quality_failure', 'returncode', 'status')}))
    require(equal(mismatches, clarification['identity_mismatches']) and len(mismatches) == 1 and mismatches[0]['run_index'] == 159 and mismatches[0]['model_index'] == 79 and
        mismatches[0]['variant'] == 'highs' and mismatches[0]['solver_sha256_before'] == '8750769bc280de96c48be7c05ecd7f776b5691d8d23e915a106d5d75dd1064fd' and
        mismatches[0]['solver_sha256_after'] == mismatches[0]['frozen_solver_sha256'] == plan['production_sha256'] and mismatches[0]['quality_failure'] == 'solver_changed_or_unavailable', '仅本次单个身份mismatch，不能解释成参考数值失败')
    require(equal(summary, C.performance_summary('highs', observed, selected['models'], selected['repeats'], variants, runner, frozen, PLAN_SHA, sha(raw_path))), '原summary按原观测重算但不修改，不将罚分用于目标比较')
    backup_spec = clarification['driver_before_correction']; backup = ROOT / backup_spec['file']
    require(sha(backup) == backup_spec['sha256'] == read(DATA / 'v108-source-build-audit.json')['driver_sha256'], '执行前原driver逐字备份与实际源码构建审计身份')
    return dict(stage='highs', evaluation_valid=False, archive_rejected=True, archive_error=str(error), public_lp_runs_observed=182, public_lp_runs_revalidated=0,
        raw_file=str(raw_path), raw_sha256=sha(raw_path), summary_file=str(summary_path), summary_sha256=sha(summary_path), original_summary_preserved=True,
        identity_mismatches=mismatches, identity_consistent_observed_rows=181, clarification_file=str(clarification_path), clarification_sha256=sha(clarification_path),
        original_driver_file=str(backup), original_driver_sha256=sha(backup), cause='unknown', current_hashes_do_not_prove_past_identity=True,
        comparison_permitted=False, additional_public_lp_runs=0)


def numerical(plan, identity):
    runner, frozen = C.protocol(plan); summaries, rows = {}, {}
    def stage(name):
        manifest, summary, raw = C.archive(name, RUNS, PLAN)
        require(manifest['work'] == str(WORK) and manifest['reference'] == str(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe') and manifest['reference_sha256'] == plan['production_sha256'] and manifest['candidate'] == identity['candidate'] and manifest['candidate_sha256'] == identity['candidate_sha256'], '阶段实际参考和候选身份')
        require(summary['valid_process_count'] == summary['run_count'] and all(summary[key] == 0 for key in ('presolve_marker_error_count', 'coupled_marker_error_count', 'energy_marker_error_count')), '全部进程/三marker合法')
        summaries[name], rows[name] = summary, raw
    for name in STAGES[:4]: stage(name)
    pairs = []
    for name in STAGES[:2]:
        for model in runner.specification(name, frozen)['models']:
            chosen = {row['requested_variant']: row for row in rows[name] if row['model_index'] == model['model_index']}
            pairs.append(dict(stage=name, input=model['input'], **runner.pair_result(chosen['frozen_v66'], chosen['diagnostic_off'], frozen)))
    require(len(pairs) == 17 and all(pair['category'] == 'equal' for pair in pairs), '17关闭完整非预算对子，仅排timings')
    compatibility = dict(passed=True, plan_sha256=PLAN_SHA, runs=34, pairs=pairs, non_budget_equal=17, budget_pairs=0, invalid_pairs=0, different_pairs=0); require(equal(compatibility, read(RUNS / 'compatibility.json')), '原兼容聚合')
    gate = runner.base.gate_decision(summaries['development'], summaries['probe']); gate.update(plan_sha256=PLAN_SHA, valid_processes=True); require(equal(gate, read(RUNS / 'gate.json')), '原门槛重算')
    require(gate['eligible_for_netlib'] is True, '本次真实gate已通过，不能重写实际阶段')
    stage('netlib'); total = sum(map(len, rows.values())); require(total == 318, '仅前五阶段318次严格核验通过')
    try:
        C.archive('highs', RUNS, PLAN)
    except RuntimeError as error:
        invalid = invalid_highs(plan, identity, runner, frozen, error)
    else:
        raise ValueError('原严格archive必须继续拒绝已记录身份异常，不得修补原件或绕过验证')

        if '--output' not in command or Path(command[1]).name not in TOOLS: continue

def package(active, directories):
